exercises.title: Prepositions — Recupera
exercises.description: Ricostruisci le preposizioni più utili per tempo, luogo, posizione e movimento.
exercises.instructions: Non tradurre parola per parola dall'italiano: usa il tipo di relazione che vuoi esprimere.

sections.title: Tempo, luogo o movimento?
sections.instructions: Prima identifica la relazione; poi scegli la preposizione.

questions.title: Prepositions: visualizza la relazione
questions.prompt: Prima di esercitarti
questions.instructions: Raggruppa le preposizioni per significato, non come lista isolata.
questions.learning_objective: Choose common prepositions for time, place, position, movement and high-frequency combinations.

content.body: Le preposizioni collegano elementi nel tempo, nello spazio e nel movimento. Impara piccoli sistemi utili: at/in/on per tempo e luogo; preposizioni di posizione; preposizioni di movimento; alcune combinazioni frequenti.
content.intro: La traduzione letterale dall'italiano spesso non funziona. Chiediti: quando? dove? in quale posizione? verso dove?

sections.title: Tempo: at, on, in
sections.body: Usa at per ore/momenti precisi, on per giorni/date, in per mesi/anni/periodi ampi.
sections.pattern: at 8:00 · on Monday · in July · in 2026

sections.title: Luogo: at, in, on
sections.body: At indica spesso un punto/luogo funzionale, in un'area o spazio, on una superficie.
sections.pattern: at school · in Bologna · in the room · on the table

examples.text: Your keys are on the desk.

sections.title: Posizione
sections.body: Usa preposizioni come under, next to, between, behind, in front of per descrivere dove si trova qualcosa.

examples.text: The bag is under the chair.
The pharmacy is next to the bank.
The café is between the station and the hotel.

sections.title: Posizione ≠ movimento
sections.body: In descrive spesso una posizione; into evidenzia il movimento verso l'interno. To indica una direzione/destinazione.

correct.text: She is in the classroom. · She walked into the classroom. · We went to the station.

incorrect.text: She walked in the classroom. (se vuoi dire che è entrata)

sections.title: Alcune combinazioni vanno imparate insieme
sections.body: Per le combinazioni frequenti è meglio memorizzare il blocco intero.

sections.title: Da ricordare
points: Tempo: at ora, on giorno/data, in mese/anno/periodo.
Luogo: guarda se è punto, area/spazio o superficie.
Posizione: visualizza dove si trova l'oggetto.
Movimento: visualizza il percorso o la destinazione.
Le collocations frequenti vanno memorizzate come blocchi.

questions.title: Tre riferimenti di tempo
questions.prompt: Completa la frase.
questions.instructions: Scegli la preposizione corretta per ogni riferimento.
questions.learning_objective: Choose at/on/in for common time expressions.

content.text_template: The course starts [[blank_1]] Monday [[blank_2]] 9:00 and finishes [[blank_3]] June.

feedback.explanation: On Monday, at 9:00, in June.

questions.title: Un luogo e una città
questions.prompt: My aunt lives ___ Florence.
questions.learning_objective: Choose in for a city location.

feedback.explanation: Con una città: live in Florence.

questions.title: Dov'è la borsa?
questions.prompt: The bag is ___ the chair, not on it.
questions.instructions: Imagine the position: it is below the chair.
questions.learning_objective: Choose a basic position preposition from spatial meaning.

feedback.explanation: Below the chair = under the chair.

questions.title: La direzione conta
questions.prompt: She opened the door and walked ___ the classroom.
questions.instructions: Scegli la forma che mostra il movimento verso l'interno.
questions.learning_objective: Choose into for movement to the inside of a place.

feedback.explanation: Il verbo walked descrive movimento verso l'interno: into.

questions.title: Una combinazione frequente
questions.prompt: Correct: I'm good in English.
questions.learning_objective: Use the common collocation good at.

feedback.explanation: La combinazione è good at.

exercises.title: Prepositions — Allenati
exercises.description: Pratica tempo, luogo, posizione, movimento e combinazioni frequenti in contesti reali.
exercises.instructions: Visualizza la relazione prima di scegliere.

questions.title: Un'agenda scolastica
questions.prompt: Complete the timetable with at, on or in.
questions.instructions: Write one preposition in each gap.
questions.learning_objective: Produce at/on/in for mixed school time expressions.

content.text_template: English is [[blank_1]] Tuesday [[blank_2]] 10:30. Exams begin [[blank_3]] May.

feedback.explanation: On Tuesday, at 10:30, in May.

questions.title: Dove sono le cose?
questions.prompt: Complete the room description.
questions.instructions: Choose the most precise position preposition.
questions.learning_objective: Use basic position prepositions in a connected room scene.

content.text_template: The desk is [[blank_1]] the window. A lamp is [[blank_2]] the desk, and the bin is [[blank_3]] the desk.

feedback.explanation: Next to, on, under descrivono tre posizioni diverse.

questions.title: Un percorso
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a sentence with a movement preposition.

feedback.explanation: Across descrive il movimento da un lato all'altro.

questions.title: Tempo tradotto troppo letteralmente
questions.prompt: Correct: We have the test in Friday.
questions.learning_objective: Correct an Italian-influenced time preposition error.

accepted_answers: We have the test on Friday.

feedback.explanation: Con i giorni della settimana: on Friday.

questions.title: Aspettami
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural reply.
questions.learning_objective: Use the high-frequency combination wait for in dialogue.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: I'm going to the bus stop.

feedback.explanation: La combinazione è wait for someone.

questions.title: Traduci posizione e movimento
questions.prompt: Il gatto è nella scatola. Poi salta fuori dalla scatola.
questions.learning_objective: Contrast a position preposition with a movement preposition.

accepted_answers: The cat is in the box. Then it jumps out of the box.
The cat is in the box. Then the cat jumps out of the box.

feedback.explanation: In = posizione; out of = movimento verso l'esterno.

questions.title: Quali combinazioni funzionano?
questions.prompt: Select all correct phrases in the sentences.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one correct answer.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise common adjective/verb-preposition combinations.

feedback.explanation: Interested in, good at, wait for sono combinazioni frequenti.

questions.title: Posizione o movimento?
questions.prompt: A student is outside the classroom, opens the door and moves to the inside. Which sentence is most precise?
questions.learning_objective: Choose a movement preposition from a described path.

options.text: The student walks into the classroom.
The student is in the classroom.
The student walks on the classroom.

feedback.explanation: Into mostra il passaggio dall'esterno all'interno.

exercises.title: Prepositions — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Applica preposizioni di tempo, luogo e movimento in formati da verifica.
exercises.instructions: Completa tutto prima di vedere il feedback.

sections.title: Verifica scolastica
sections.instructions: Usa il contesto, non la traduzione letterale.

questions.title: Complete the text
questions.prompt: Complete with the correct prepositions.
questions.instructions: Write one preposition in each gap.
questions.learning_objective: Produce time and place prepositions in connected text.

content.text_template: I live [[blank_1]] Bologna. My lesson is [[blank_2]] Wednesday [[blank_3]] 4 p.m.

feedback.explanation: In Bologna, on Wednesday, at 4 p.m.

questions.title: Correct the mistake
questions.prompt: Correct: The keys are in the table.
questions.instructions: The keys are resting on the surface. Rewrite the sentence.
questions.learning_objective: Correct in/on for a surface relationship.

accepted_answers: The keys are on the table.

feedback.explanation: Su una superficie: on the table.

questions.title: Choose the correct answer
questions.prompt: The shop is ___ the bank and the café.
questions.instructions: The bank is on one side and the café on the other.
questions.learning_objective: Choose between for a two-reference position.

feedback.explanation: Fra due riferimenti: between.

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: Attraversiamo il parco e poi entriamo nel museo.
questions.learning_objective: Produce movement prepositions across and into in one sentence.

accepted_answers: We walk across the park and then go into the museum.
We cross the park and then go into the museum.

feedback.explanation: Across = da un lato all'altro; into = verso l'interno.

questions.title: Make a sentence
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a sentence with an adjective-preposition collocation.

feedback.explanation: Interested in music.

questions.title: Complete the route
questions.prompt: Choose the correct movement prepositions.
questions.learning_objective: Choose movement prepositions from a short route description.

content.text_template: Walk [[blank_1]] the bridge, then go [[blank_2]] the building through the main door.

feedback.explanation: Across the bridge, into the building.

exercises.title: Prepositions — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma su tempo, luogo, posizione, movimento e combinazioni frequenti.
exercises.instructions: Completa senza aiuti. Il feedback arriva solo alla fine.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Visualizza tempo, posizione o percorso prima di rispondere.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: Complete the schedule.
questions.learning_objective: Apply at/on/in across three time scales.

content.text_template: The meeting is [[blank_1]] Friday [[blank_2]] 2 p.m. The next course starts [[blank_3]] September.

feedback.explanation: On Friday, at 2 p.m., in September.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.prompt: The notice is attached to the surface of the wall. It is ___ the wall.
questions.learning_objective: Choose on for surface location.

feedback.explanation: Superficie: on the wall.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.prompt: Complete the room description.
questions.learning_objective: Produce position prepositions in connected spatial context.

content.text_template: The chair is [[blank_1]] the desk. The bag is [[blank_2]] the chair.

feedback.explanation: Next to/beside e under descrivono la scena.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.prompt: Correct: The lesson starts on 8:30.
questions.learning_objective: Correct the preposition before a clock time.

feedback.explanation: Ora precisa: at 8:30.

questions.title: Item 5
questions.prompt: Vivo a Bologna e studio in biblioteca il sabato mattina.
questions.learning_objective: Produce place and time prepositions in one natural sentence.

accepted_answers: I live in Bologna and study in the library on Saturday morning.
I live in Bologna and I study in the library on Saturday morning.

feedback.explanation: In Bologna, in the library, on Saturday morning.

questions.title: Item 6
questions.prompt: Select all correct sentences.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one answer.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise three high-frequency preposition collocations.

feedback.explanation: Good at, wait for, interested in.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a sentence describing movement across a space.

feedback.explanation: Across = da un lato all'altro.

questions.title: Item 8
questions.prompt: Follow the route from outside to inside.
questions.learning_objective: Choose movement prepositions in a multi-step route.

content.text_template: Walk [[blank_1]] the road, then go [[blank_2]] the station through the glass doors.

feedback.explanation: Across the road; into the station.

questions.title: Item 9
questions.prompt: Correct: She walked in the building from the street. (She entered it.)
questions.instructions: Rewrite using the preposition that makes the movement into the building clear.
questions.learning_objective: Correct a position preposition when movement into a place is intended.

accepted_answers: She walked into the building from the street.

feedback.explanation: Into rende esplicito il movimento verso l'interno.

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: Lunedì alle nove ci incontriamo davanti alla scuola, poi attraversiamo la strada e andiamo nella biblioteca.
questions.learning_objective: Produce time, position and movement prepositions in one connected context.

accepted_answers: On Monday at nine, we meet in front of the school, then cross the road and go into the library.
On Monday at nine, we're meeting in front of the school, then we cross the road and go into the library.

feedback.explanation: On Monday, at nine, in front of, across/cross, into.
